chapter_title_en: Stirrings Beyond the Seas – Claiming the Cauldron
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 499: Han Li Claims the Void Heaven Cauldron and Faces Xuan Gu’s Betrayal
chapter_meta_description: Han Li finally claims the legendary Void Heaven Cauldron, but Xuan Gu’s triumphant laughter signals a deadly betrayal. The Asura Holy Flame is born.
og_title: Han Li Claims the Void Heaven Cauldron—Only to Face Cold-Blooded Betrayal
og_description: The moment the Void Heaven Cauldron is in Han Li’s hands, Xuan Gu drops his mask. A masterful scene of icy betrayal and the birth of a forbidden flame.
twitter_title: Han Li Wins the Prize—Then Everything Falls Apart
twitter_description: The Void Heaven Cauldron is won, but the alliance was a trap. Xuan Gu reveals his true plan and Han Li strikes first.

lore_anchors.definition: The legendary supreme treasure of the Chaotic Star Sea, sealed deep within the Void Heaven Palace. Its carvings evoke an ancient, primordial aura.
An extremely powerful yin-cold flame that can freeze spiritual power itself. It was originally wrapped around the Void Heaven Cauldron as a seal.
A yin-aligned flame technique cultivated by Xuan Gu, used here to briefly separate the Azure Ice Flame from the cauldron.
A legendary, forbidden fusion flame said to be created by combining Azure Ice Flame, Profound Soul Ghostfire, and Evil-Repelling Divine Lightning.
A yang-aligned lightning that naturally destroys yin-type entities. It is a component of the proposed Asura Holy Flame fusion.
A pair-bonded spirit spider species. Only a male-female pair can advance in rank, making a live pair essential for retrieving the Void Heaven Cauldron.
A set of five copper rings given to Han Li as a test gift by Extreme Yin Patriarch. They can vanish and reappear to bind a target’s limbs and neck.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li suspect the cauldron might be fake?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because in the Mortal Stream, a victory that comes too easily is the most dangerous kind. Han Li’s paranoia has been trained by a lifetime of near-misses and setups.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Asura Holy Flame?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a legendary forbidden flame said to be formed by fusing three opposing energies: the yin-cold Azure Ice Flame, the yin-ghost Profound Soul Ghostfire, and the yang-holy Evil-Repelling Divine Lightning.
